title: Generalised Probabilistic Theories
summary: We give an introduction to research associated with the generalised probabilistic theories framework, also known as the convex framework. States are real vectors representing lists of probabilities of measurement outcomes. Convex combinations of the vectors represent probabilistic combinations of different state preparations. Transformations are real matrices. Measurement outcomes are represented by functionals of the states, inner products of the state with a real vector, whose values are the probability of the measurement outcome in question.
